page_title: JUV 3-1 LAZ | Juventus v Lazio 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
90+4' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle after Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Lazio have a free kick from a promising distance.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
85' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
84' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moise Kean (Juventus) replacing Dusan Vlahovic.
83' The substitution is prepared. Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Federico Chiesa.
82' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
80' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adrien Rabiot (Juventus). Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' Here is a change. Daichi Kamada is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio).
77' The expression of the referee Fabio Maresca is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is shown a yellow card.
76' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' A substitution has been made. Felipe Anderson goes off and Pedro (Lazio) comes on.
72' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Weston McKennie and he is replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
71' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' Substitution. Ciro Immobile did his best and is replaced by Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
67' 3 - 1 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a brilliant pass and sends a long-range shot past the helpless goalkeeper. What a cracking goal!
64' 2 - 1 Luis Alberto (Lazio) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
61' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
61' Luis Alberto (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
59' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Filip Kostic will be replaced by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabio Miretti leaves the pitch and Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) comes on.
56' Lazio fail to score from a corner as Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) leaps to collect the ball.
54' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

52' Luis Alberto (Lazio) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
50' A cross from a corner kick by Juventus is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
49' A header by Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Ivan Provedel, who makes a brilliant save. Juventus get a corner.
47' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
46' Maurizio Sarri makes a switch. Luca Pellegrini is coming on in place of Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) at the start of the second period.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Danilo Cataldi is replaced by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio).
46' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+2' Lazio will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The percentage of ball possession is – 35:65.

43' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
42' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

41' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
39' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
38' Fabio Maresca couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) and blew his whistle.
37' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) jumps into a tackle and Fabio Maresca signals a foul.
34' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

32' A neat pass is well received by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
32' Lazio fail to score from a corner as Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) leaps to collect the ball.

31' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

30' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
29' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

28' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' 2 - 0 Federico Chiesa (Juventus) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes inside the left post.
26' None of the Lazio players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

25' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Wojciech Szczesny, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Lazio win a corner.
24' We are about to witness a long-range indirect free kick by Lazio. From a position like this it's difficult to score.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
18' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' Bremer (Juventus) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
16' A cross from a corner kick by Juventus is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
16' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Ivan Provedel (Lazio).
15' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

15' Filip Kostic (Juventus) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Ivan Provedel has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
11' Referee Fabio Maresca points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes wild in celebration.
11' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Juventus can stand using VAR.
10' 1 - 0 A wonderful cross found Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) in the box who shows good control of the ball and sends it inside the right post.
8' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
6' Wow, what an escape. Federico Chiesa (Juventus) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
4' Flag goes up against Bremer (Juventus) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' Lazio are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
